description: Ads from Meta's official Ad Library API, by keyword or page IDs and country: ad ID, page, funding byline, creation and delivery dates, creative texts, snapshot URL, platforms, languages and, for political or issue ads, spend and impression ranges; EU reach for EU ads. Covers political/issue ads worldwide and all ads delivered in the EU/UK. Needs the operator's free Ad Library API token. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

adType.description: ALL or POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS (default). ALL only returns ads for EU/UK countries

country.description: Two-letter country the ads reached, e.g. US, DE (ALL for every country)

pageIds.description: Up to 10 Facebook page IDs, comma separated

name: social_facebook_ads_library
title: Social Facebook Ads Library
